sentences.text: Shifty is a British urban crime thriller , written and directed by Eran Creevy .	Eran Creevy	Eran Creevy
Set on the outskirts of London , it follows themes of friendship and loyalty over the course of twenty-four hours in the life of a young drug dealer , the charismatic Shifty .	London	London
Shifty was filmed predominantly in Borehamwood , Hertfordshire , the home of Elstree Studios .

Based on Eran Creevy 's teenage experiences , and boasting convincing performances from a cast of rising stars , as well as veteran actors Jason Flemyng and Francesca Annis , the film was funded by Film London 's Microwave scheme and delivered after a shooting schedule of just eighteen days .	Eran Creevy	Eran Creevy	Jason Flemyng	Jason Flemyng	Francesca Annis	Francesca Annis	London	London
